title: Babylon Fortress
scope: The surviving Roman masonry around the former canal entrance at Babylon Fortress in Old Cairo, including both round towers and the south gate beneath the Hanging Church.
limitations: The modeled north tower stops at the Roman wall beneath Saint George. The unrelated church superstructures and museum are separate physical structures.
The dates of the surveys differ from the current setting. The historic gate sections, exact interior floor elevations, exposed masonry breaks and archaeological court levels are approximated.
